title: False positive: string-formatted INSERT in test seed data
evidence: demo-store-api/tests/test_search.py:13 builds an INSERT with an f-string, but the values come from the loop index and the hardcoded SEED_EMAILS constant (test_search.py:7, 12). The code runs only in the pytest seed() helper against a temporary DB (tmp_path, lines 18-20). It is not part of any HTTP route, so no attacker input reaches it.
recommended_fix: No security fix is needed. Optionally use placeholders (conn.execute("INSERT INTO orders VALUES (?, ?, 10.0, 'OPEN')", (i, email))) as good practice, or exclude tests/ from this rule.
